Class FileProductRepository

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.model.repository.impl.FileProductRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProductRepository
public class FileProductRepository extends Object implements ProductRepository
FileProductRepository provides a file-based implementation of the ProductRepository interface. This implementation stores product data in a serialized file format and maintains an in-memory cache of product objects for fast access. It supports basic CRUD operations and advanced search capabilities including category filtering, low stock detection, and expiration tracking.
